content.short: On-chain risk curator running cbBTC, ETH, USDC and EURC vaults and managing vaults for treasuries.
content.description: Founded by people active in crypto since 2016, 9Summits has been managing capital on-chain since September 2020. It runs its own flagship vaults on Lagoon for cbBTC, ETH, USDC and EURC, builds and operates vaults for treasuries and protocols on Morpho, Euler and Silo, and structures new isolated lending markets. Its stated rule is to protect capital first and compound returns second, reading the contracts behind every yield source before allocating.
content.meta: 9Summits curates on-chain vaults on Lagoon, Morpho, Euler and Silo, putting capital protection ahead of chasing yield.
